title: Prabowo Launches 11 Nickel Downstreaming Projects Worth Rp180 Trillion in North Maluku
detail: On October 8, 2026, President Prabowo Subianto launched 11 downstreaming projects, worth about Rp180 trillion (roughly $10.2 billion), at the Indonesia Weda Bay Industrial Park in Central Halmahera, North Maluku. Four of the projects are completed and entering commercialization; seven are new and starting construction. Products include equipment for trucks, mining and industry, and photovoltaic glass. Prabowo said cumulative investment in the park exceeds $20 billion, with a further $7 billion planned, and that it has created over 100,000 jobs. Chinese-backed investors are prominent in the park.
